messages:
Mira Chen: Quick sync 1: setting up the 'Carousel' early-preview cohort next week. Need final confirmations, screener form, and enablement slots. Who can own invites + screener?
Rafael Ortiz: I can take invites + screener. Will spin up a Typeform and wire the webhook to /hooks/cs-enroll. Will post draft by EOD. :+1:
Samir Patel: Pls add an SSO checkbox and a field for current auth method (API key / SSO). Two customers need SAML attribute mapping so well flag them.
Mira Chen: Good call. Add a "requires SAML mapping" tag and a "priority outreach" flag for renewal-watch accounts: NovaPay, LatticeHealth, Finch Labs.
Rafael Ortiz: Will add priority labels. Tentative send: Tue 09:00 PT. Enablement slots WedFri.
Jo Kim: I can run Wed 10am PT and Thu 3pm PT. Need the deck updated  any content changes?
Mira Chen: Small changes: include the new webhook auth snippet, explicit preview rate limits (20 r/s baseline, 100 burst if Dedicated), and a note about data retention for preview datasets. I'll drop a short PR to the deck in drive: https://drive.redwood/example-deck-placeholder
Onboard Bot: template created  /templates/preview-carousel-screener-v1. Fields: company, contact, env (prod/staging), sample_prompt, expected_peak_qps, recording_ok. Webhook set to /hooks/cs-enroll.
Rafael Ortiz: Draft form (testing): https://forms.typeform.com/to/CaroselDraft321  test responses welcome. Webhook example for devs:
```json
{
  "event": "submission",
  "data": {
    "company": "Finch Labs",
    "sample_prompt": "Extract key specs from spec.md",
    "expected_peak_qps": "40",
    "auth_method": "SSO",
    "recording_ok": "yes"
  }
}
```
Samir Patel: Nice. I'll use the sample_prompt to prepare a short eval suite and annotate any model/quantization recs. Add a latency tolerance field too (ms).
Mira Chen: Add that latency tolerance field. Also include an opt-out blurb for recordings and a one-line privacy note. Keep customer comms short.
Rafael Ortiz: Done  added "latency_tolerance_ms" and the opt-out checkbox. Sharing live form link once I flip to production.
Jo Kim: I'll record one session and upload to drive for folks who miss it. Also prepping a 10-min welcome + live Q&A plan.
Samir Patel: I'll prepare a perf checklist and a perf smoke test to run during onboarding (small prompt set + baseline latency check).
Mira Chen: Action recap: Rafael  publish form + share link by 1700 PT; Jo & Samir  review slides & perf notes by EOD tomorrow; I'll schedule invites once link is live and start outreach to priority accounts. Ping this thread when live. :spiral_calendar_pad:
Rafael Ortiz: Will post the production link here by 1700 PT. Thanks team.
Jo Kim: :thumbsup: will block sessions and note recording.
Samir Patel: I'll annotate the enrollment list with perf flags once Rafael posts the roster.
Mira Chen: Great work. We'll run cohort onboarding next week and iterate on the screener after first 10 responses. :rocket:
